title: neurocarpum laurifolium
intro: Neurocarpum laurifolium, commonly known as Laurifolia or Bitter Ash, is a plant species that belongs to the family Celastraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, alleviating respiratory issues, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it a potential treatment for conditions like bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Neurocarpum laurifolium include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
